body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0081 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Sysmon: Registry Run key persistence (CurrentVersion\\\\Run) - Detects registry value sets in Run/RunOnce keys which can indicate persistence."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0081"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1547.001"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION")
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "13"
    $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run(once)?\\/ nocase
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $name_ = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $name, $name_ over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $registry_paths = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_key)
    $details = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_value_data)
    $images = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $e
}
